Personal Project

CUSTOM FITNESS TRACKING

Apple's Health and Activity apps don't show the stats I want to see, so I built my own custom app. I exported 5.6 million lines of raw XML Health data, parsed it into Parquet, and charted things like heatmaps of workout volume/type, pace on repeat routes, pace by heart-rate zone, workout type distribution with custom categories, gym PRs, and other stats exactly how I want to see them!
